en.title: Food label scan — AIGLOSSA FOOD
en.description: Scan a food label and get a clear nutrition report, ingredient explanations, and general notes for who should pay attention.
en.h1: Read the label. Understand the food.
en.sub: Scan ingredients, nutrition facts, or an imported package. Get a clear report in seconds — not medical advice.

en.insufficient: Not enough credits. Buy credits to continue.

en.image_invalid: This image could not be read. Try a clearer photo.
en.scan_timeout: This is taking longer than usual. You can check history in a moment.

en.delete_body: The report and image will be deleted.
en.value_1_body: Every unfamiliar word, explained: what it is, why it is there, and who should note it.
en.value_2_body: Per 100g, per serving and NRV together — high, medium and low in a way you can read.
en.value_3_body: General notes for people who may need to watch sodium, sugar, allergens, or additives.
en.footer_disclaimer: For general nutrition information only. Not medical advice.
en.install_hint: Add aiglossa food to your home screen for faster scanning.

en.energy_note: kcal and kJ are two units for the same energy; 1 kcal ≈ 4.184 kJ.
